Senior Backend Engineer

Acme Robotics is looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to help build the fleet-coordination services behind our warehouse robots.

Required:
- 5+ years building production backend services in Node.js or Go
- Experience with distributed systems and message queues
- Comfortable owning a service end to end, from design to on-call

Bonus points for:
- Experience with robotics or real-time systems
- Familiarity with Kubernetes

You will mentor junior engineers on the team and participate in system design reviews.

Software Engineer

Quietfirm is looking for a Software Engineer with 3+ years of experience in TypeScript and REST API design. Must be comfortable working directly with clients.

Platform Engineer

We need a Platform Engineer with strong AWS and Terraform experience, 4+ years required.

Staff Engineer

Staff Engineer role requiring 8+ years of experience, deep expertise in distributed systems, and a track record of mentoring senior engineers. Must have led at least one major architecture migration.
